measurement_definitions.meaningful_body_turn: Speed>5m/s and speed*absolute finite-difference rear-axle yawrate>1m/s²; kinematic turn proxy, not measured tireforce.
measurement_definitions.sample_seconds: Count of qualifying20ms command records times.02; boundary-record convention differs by at mostone tick from interval integration.
measurement_definitions.corners: 18 predeclared original-map curvature anchors. Entry/exit±30originalmapmetres; not a claim of exact actual apex. Adjacent windows mayoverlap and are not summed as independent trials.
measurement_definitions.combined_proxy: hypot(raw one-tick speed-derivative estimate,estimated body lateral demand fromcommand). Neither term is measured tireforce; raw derivative is noisy.
measurement_definitions.clearance: Offline5Hz projected full3Dbox-footprint minimum, not continuous-time/contact sensor measurement. Native20ms conservative supervisor overlap audit is separate.

comparison_scope: Finite single-run engineering ablations; fixed map, profiles, hardware/grip, weights, road rule, initial scene and rival settings. Different closed-loop trajectories remain possible.
observed_track_scope: Union of provided hazards and retained/coasted measured identities; no top-N; not all unseen cars or omniscient ground truth.
